subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 12 updates

question: After all three stale pin assertions are repaired and exact-head checks finish, should OpenClaw accept this combined GitHub Actions update across token-bearing, Docker, CodeQL/SARIF, labeling, setup, and Codex-agent workflows?
rationale: The mechanical test repair is clear and upstream commits are verified, but accepting replacement third-party code in secret-bearing and write-capable jobs is a repository trust decision automation cannot safely make.

options.title: Repair Then Review Batch
options.body: Update every stale assertion, finish exact-head validation, and require security/workflow-owner acceptance of the combined pins.

options.title: Split Sensitive Updates
options.body: Recreate narrower PRs for app-token, Codex, Docker, scanning, and setup actions if maintainers want smaller trust-review units.

options.title: Accept Combined Batch
options.body: A security/workflow owner may intentionally accept the complete verified batch after documenting the trust decision and validation result.

recommendation.title: Repair Then Review Batch
recommendation.body: Update every stale assertion, finish exact-head validation, and require security/workflow-owner acceptance of the combined pins.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame ties the affected workflow guards and secret-bearing steps most directly to this owner's recent work.
